Yes, he definitely believes this. His arrogance and hubris are clinical and blasphemous. 

And he knows so little about Christianity that he doesn’t even know you’re not supposed to compare yourself to Jesus Christ. And yet he poses as the Savior. It doesn’t get worse than that.

We can’t stay in this war. We’re flirting with global economic disaster. And Israel won’t let us leave. I don’t know how this gets resolved. How much economic pain will America bear before it starts to chafe at this absurd level of control that another country exercises on us?

If Trump is still making offers like this, then he’s just a sad servant of Israel. He’s a puppet through which they talk. This offer doesn’t help American interests one bit. I don’t think we’re in charge of our own government.

Is this a joke? Does Trump just not understand that we have lost leverage since the war began. These are the same maximalist Israeli demands as before the war began. Why the hell would they take that? This is not a peace offer, it’s an F U note from Israel to Iran.


Mary Margaret Olohan (@MaryMargOlohan)

U.S. official tells @realDailyWire that these are the United States' red lines for Iran: 

- Iran must end all uranium enrichment
- Dismantle all major nuclear enrichment facilities 
- Retriev

Only way out is to make this simple deal: 1. We leave. 2. They open up Strait of Hormuz. Period. No interfering with their enrichment or foreign policy. They're never going to agree to that and it's not our business. If Israel doesn't like that, that's their problem, not ours.

Trump is retaliating against Iran by double closing the Strait of Hormuz. So, now Iran's oil can't get out either. Ok, but what will that do to oil prices? Make them much higher!! And that will hurt our economy very badly. So, ironically, that only INCREASES Iran's leverage.

I think we’re used to getting everything we want. But that’s not how the real world works. The Iranians have closed the Strait of Hormuz and can now use the world economy as leverage. I don’t think we understand the position we’re in. Israel has put us in an untenable place.

The old dividing line was Left vs. Right. And I’m sure we’ll get back to that at some point. But right now, the new dividing lines are Patriots vs. Israelis. Grassroots vs Establishment. American forces have assembled online and can’t wait to defeat the establishment and MSM.

It's weird how little national media is talking about this. Do they think it's a national security issue to discuss this? Do they think Iran is unaware of this calculus. They say they're perfectly aware of it. In fact, they're trying to get us to waste our defensive missiles.

Here's a critical part of the war no one is talking about - we're running low on interceptor missiles. Once we run out, we have to leave. Otherwise our ships are sitting ducks. So, we might not have a choice on whether to end the war. Staying past that can only make things worse.

I don’t think Trump is any different than he’s ever been. He’s always been nuts. When you’re winning, it looks like brash confidence with a dangerous swagger. When you’re losing, it looks like a deranged, sweaty tooth madman. That’s the stage we’re in now.
